section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews evidence that self-compassion fluctuates within persons and summarizes two daily-diary studies (Breines et al., 2014; Kelly & Stephen, 2016) showing that on days when college women are more self-compassionate than usual they report healthier eating and better body appreciation. It highlights that these findings are from college/undergraduate samples and calls for studies examining whether within-person increases in self-compassion buffer the effects of body-image stressors on eating and body-image outcomes.
